title: SC Directs RBI on Mule Accounts SOP & IRDAI on ANPR Motor Insurance Verification
summary: Judicial directives accelerate inter-regulatory SOPs to freeze cyber-fraud accounts and enforce motor insurance.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SC Directs RBI on Mule Accounts SOP & IRDAI on ANPR Motor Insurance Verification. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Judicial directives accelerate inter-regulatory SOPs to freeze cyber-fraud accounts and enforce motor insurance.
Supreme Court directed **RBI** to circulate SOP for dealing with **mule accounts** linked to cyber fraud.
RBI combating tools: Uses **MuleHunter.AI** in collaboration with **I4C** (Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre under MHA).
SC directed Central Govt & **IRDAI** to pilot **Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR)**-based insurance verification at fuel stations to deny fuel sales to uninsured vehicles.
MuleHunter.AI (RBI AI tool) vs I4C (MHA national cyber crime coordination portal).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
